name: session-deck
description: A pane beside the chat with the model in use, context fill, plan usage limits and their forecast, plan progress, subagents and scheduled tasks

handoffAt.title: Handoff mark
handoffAt.description: Context percent the deck marks for a handoff, with a toast when it is reached and a warning 10 points earlier

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: What the deck pins under the prompt: full (context and limits), limits (for a status line that already shows context) or off

checklist.title: Session checklist
checklist.description: Things to do at the start of every session, as Label=Tool or Label=Tool:path part, split by semicolons. The pane ticks each when its tool runs, and the first prompt of a session tells Claude what is still open
